Ek toh yeh jo locha hai. Recently a new joinee informed us Stand-up mein ki task nahi hua hai because access nahi hai usske paas Azure Migrate pe replication status dekhne ka. I said bhai aise kaise tu same access control group pe added hai
Baad mein bataaya ussko bhai “classic” mode mein switch kar tab dikhega

I use the new version on a Mac. Looks better but every so often, it starts failing to search for old emails that I know are in my inbox. I have been in this company for 11 years, sometimes i need to find an email with attachments from 2017. Copilot shows me a link to the email, but when I try to open it, it gives me the very informative error message that “the email has not been downloaded.” To download karo na, that’s your job not mine! IT helpdesk has to rebuild my Outlook profile for it to work. Or I have to use webmail.
